rationale: Both describe impaired/dysfunctional respiratory system outcomes at the organ/disease level using different wording.
Both describe bone-level changes (remodeling vs. loss) that are closely related but represent distinct processes at the same organ level.
Impaired oligodendrocyte maturation and decreased oligodendrocyte differentiation describe the same biological process of oligodendrocyte development failure.
Both involve glutathione (GSH) but depletion and conjugation are distinct processes — conjugation is one mechanism that can lead to depletion.
Increased fat mass, adipocyte size, adipocyte numbers, and lipid accumulation all describe increased adiposity but at different levels of biological specificity (organ vs. cellular vs. molecular).
Both describe an increase in fat mass using essentially the same wording.
IAV binding to sialic acid glycan receptor and IAV cell entry describe the same initial step of viral infection.
IAV budding and IAV shedding/transmission describe consecutive steps of the same viral egress process and are functionally synonymous at this level.
Vascular endothelial dysfunction and vascular barrier disruption both describe breakdown of endothelial integrity and function.
Cardiac fibrosis and cardiac remodelling are related but distinct processes — fibrosis is a specific pathological component of the broader remodelling process.
Both describe increased afterdepolarizations (early premature depolarizations during repolarization and delayed/early afterdepolarizations) in cardiac electrophysiology.
Aromatase induction and inhibition of aromatase activity describe opposite directional changes to the same enzyme.
Both describe increased estradiol availability/levels in plasma using different wording.

Stressor binding to PPAR isoforms, disrupted PPAR nuclear signaling, and dysregulation of PPAR signaling network all involve PPAR but represent distinct processes from binding to downstream transcriptional effects.
Decreased sodium uptake in gills leads directly to decreased plasma sodium concentrations and both describe decreased sodium in the fish osmoregulatory system, though at different compartments.
Increased lysolecithin and increased lysolecithin cell membrane integration share the same biological object but describe production vs. membrane integration processes.
Hypomyelination and increased demyelination both describe reduced myelin but represent distinct processes — developmental failure to form myelin vs. acquired loss of myelin.
Altered cholesterol metabolism and increased cholesterol synthesis enzymes both relate to cholesterol homeostasis but describe different levels of specificity.
Increased androgen receptor protein expression and increased androgen receptor activation involve the same receptor but describe distinct processes — expression level vs. functional activation.
Increased delay in heart electrical conduction and altered cardiac electrical conduction describe the same electrophysiological abnormality.
Decreased DNA methylation and elevated gene expression of FAM50B/PTCHD3 share the same gene target but represent epigenetic and transcriptional processes respectively.
Increased lipid droplets and increased fat mass describe lipid accumulation at different biological scales — cellular vs. whole-organism.

Disrupted TCA cycle and disrupted energy metabolism are closely related, with TCA disruption being a key component of energy metabolism disruption, but these represent different levels of specificity.

Elevated mitochondrial ROS and dysfunction and activation of oxidative stress pathway both describe oxidative stress but one specifies the mitochondrial compartment while the other is a general pathway activation.
Inhibition of MCT8 and inhibition of OATP1C1 both involve thyroid hormone transporter inhibition but target distinct transporter proteins.

Binding of extracellular matrix protein laminin, disrupted laminin-beta1-integrin receptor binding, and decreased neural progenitor cell adhesion to laminin all involve laminin interactions but describe distinct molecular and cellular processes.
Generation of gluten-reactive T cell receptors and generation of gluten-reactive and TG2-reactive B cell receptors describe parallel receptor generation processes in the same immune response context.
Gluten-reactive CD4+ T cell activation and gluten-reactive B cell activation describe the same process (immune cell activation) in different cell type contexts.
Increased cardiac stress and decreased left ventricular function both describe cardiac impairment but at different levels — a stressor input vs. a functional output.
Hypomyelination and altered white brain matter describe related outcomes at different scales — cellular myelin deficit vs. tissue-level white matter change.
Impaired axonal insulation and hypomyelination both describe the same outcome of insufficient myelin surrounding axons.
Increased SREBP2 expression and increased cholesterol synthesis enzymes share the same cholesterol biosynthesis pathway but represent upstream transcription factor vs. downstream enzyme expression.
Decreased Bcl-2 (anti-apoptotic) and increased Bax (pro-apoptotic) expression are directionally opposite changes to apoptosis regulators that together promote apoptosis.
Increased lipid accumulation and increased lipid droplets both describe the same cellular process of intracellular lipid storage.
Increase in pro-inflammatory mediators and increased pro-inflammatory cytokine expression describe the same upregulation of inflammatory signaling molecules.
Activation of MEK/ERK1/2 and activation of MAPK describe overlapping but potentially distinct activation events within the MAPK signaling cascade.
Ryanodine receptor activation and hyperphosphorylation of RyR2 both involve the ryanodine receptor but describe distinct processes — functional activation vs. post-translational modification.

HCN channel inhibition and reduced pacemaker activity in SA node describe related electrophysiological events where HCN inhibition is a molecular mechanism and SA node pacemaker reduction is the cellular outcome.
Steroidogenesis dysregulation and reduction in estradiol/11-KT ratio both describe disrupted steroid hormone production but at different levels of specificity.
Altered white brain matter and impaired axonal insulation describe myelin-related deficits at tissue vs. cellular levels.
Increased progesterone resistance and endometriosis are closely linked in the same disease pathway but represent a molecular mechanism vs. a disease outcome.
Abnormal cardiac structure and function and decreased left ventricular function both describe cardiac functional impairment but at different levels of specificity.
